title: The EV Bust Creating a New Battery Boom

summary: Factories built to supply America’s electric-vehicle boom are getting a second life making batteries for the power grid. The shift is visible at TransGrid’s Atlas projects in Arizona, where the contractor Qcells is using LG Energy Solution’s US-made battery cells. (Source: Bloomberg)
